# Example: Housing Data Analysis

Now, let's turn our attention to real data! This is the Zillow dataset, which is available on Moodle.

```{r}
rent <- read_csv("./data/zillow_rent.csv")
```

Let's look at the data!

Assume that rent prices are random samples that are independent. (Is this true?) Let's filter the dataset to include two states of interest:

```{r}
rent <- rent %>%
  filter(state %in% c("North Carolina", "South Carolina"))
```
